query.text: 请陪我逛逛景区，如果我对路过的景点提问，请帮我解答。
query.text_en: Please accompany me around the scenic area and help answer any questions I might have about the sights we pass by.

annotation.text_zh: 虽然无法确认这座凉亭的具体历史，但它是一座典型的中式传统凉亭，主要供游客歇息和观景。
annotation.text_en: Although the specific history of this pavilion cannot be confirmed, it is a typical traditional Chinese pavilion, mainly for tourists to rest and view the scenery.
